target.title: Visualizer polish: unclipped chrome, verbatim typing captions, overlay coalescing
target.body:
Addresses the visualizer feedback round: clipped chip gradients, masked typing dots, stale-sender rectangles, and animation spam from rapid agent action streams.

## Changes

### Clipped gradients ("weird border")
HUD chip shadows and glows were drawn to the edge of their overlay window and cut off into a hard rectangle. Every overlay window now gets a 40pt chrome margin (content stays centered); views that fill their window and position content in window-local coordinates (comets, capture flash, element sheets) opt out and carry their own breathing room. Verified programmatically: max alpha along the outermost pixel border of the typing and hotkey chips is 0.

### Typing shows the actual text
The typing caption streams the typed text verbatim again - that is the point of the caption. Masking now applies only where it belongs:
- keystrokes delivered into a secure text field (AXSecureTextField) mask as bullets before the event is persisted or displayed. Detection samples the delivery focus before and after typing, scoped to the target app for background PID typing; direct value writes into secure fields are already refused by the action driver (secureValueNotAllowed).
- PEEKABOO_VISUALIZER_MASK_TYPED_TEXT=true masks everything for privacy-sensitive setups.

### Stale-sender rectangles healed at the receiver
The elementDetection payload now carries a coordinate-space marker. New senders convert to AppKit coordinates and mark the payload; the receiver flips unmarked (legacy) payloads against the primary display, so older CLIs/MCP servers stop drawing vertically mirrored rectangles. The marker is an optional Codable field - old receivers ignore it, old payloads still decode.

### Verbosity: throttles and replace slots
- Throttles: screenshot flash >= 1.2s apart, scroll chips >= 0.3s, mouse comets >= 0.4s and only for moves >= 80pt, element sheets >= 1.0s. Throttled events report success without drawing.
- Replace slots: typing caption, hotkey chip, menu breadcrumb, Space indicator, app toast, watch HUD, annotated screenshot, and per-screen element sheets keep at most one live overlay; a new event crossfades the previous one out in 0.12s.
- Element sheets render all highlights for a screen in one overlay window (previously one NSWindow per element), drop degenerate/window-sized container rects, and cap at 120 highlights preferring the smallest (actual controls).

## Verification
- PeekabooVisualizer 12/12 tests (payload decode compatibility, legacy flip, container filtering, window-local rects, mask semantics, typing pacing)
- Full CLI suite green alongside review; AutomationKit/Core/CLI packages build clean
- Harness proofs: edge alpha 0 on chips (no clipping), verbatim caption with rapid bursts crossfading through one slot, legacy top-left payload rendered at the correct flipped position, second back-to-back flash throttled

## Review trail
Three autoreview cycles. Accepted and fixed: secure-field sampling raced trailing-return focus moves (now samples before and after typing) and missed background PID typing (now scoped to the delivery process). Consciously rejected: restoring mask-by-default - explicit product decision by the owner; the caption mirrors content the target app already displays, events are user-local and transient, and the secure-field + env mitigations ship with it. Also rejected: a compatibility shim for the revealsTypedText: label introduced earlier the same day and never released.
